description: This file defines the class SugarRelationshipFactory, which creates and manages relationship objects within SuiteCRM, a CRM platform built on SugarCRM Community Edition. It includes methods for loading, caching, and retrieving relationship definitions, as well as constructing specific relationship objects based on configuration.

classes.name: SugarRelationshipFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating, caching, and retrieving relationship objects in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SugarRelationshipFactory.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns a relationship object for a given relationship name.

methods.name: getRelationshipDef
methods.description: Returns the raw relationship definition array for a given relationship name.

methods.name: loadRelationships
methods.description: Loads relationship definitions from cache or builds them anew.

methods.name: buildRelationshipCache
methods.description: Builds and caches the relationships definitions by scanning module vardefs.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Returns the filepath of the relationship cache file.
